Laura / Susan — I reviewed CareBridge_Redlines_20270528.docx and annotated the PDF. Summary of legal positions and suggested language:

1) SCCs / Transfer approach:
- We accept Standard Contractual Clauses (controller-processor module) with Redwood’s standard transfer addendum. No additional transfer-impact addendum will be required for the pilot provided CareBridge accepts controller obligations in Section 2 (data minimization + export approvals).

2) Delegation & subprocessors:
- CareBridge asked for a broad delegation right. We can offer a constrained sub-delegation model: Redwood may engage subprocessors for infrastructure and telemetry processing; any new subprocessor materially processing customer personal data will be notified in writing 30 days before onboarding. We cannot accept a blanket prior-approval right; instead offer a 30-day notice + opt-out for critical categories.

3) Export controls / egress:
- We can add explicit confirmation that customer data will not be exported outside EU for the EU-only hosting option. For non-EU backup/analytics (if applicable) we will pseudonymize telemetry and require CareBridge’s signoff.

4) Contract redlines: see inline comments in attached. Key asks to approve:
- Accept constrained sub-delegation (notice + opt-out for critical subprocessors).
- Insert EU-hosting addendum clause in order form referencing the setup surcharge / credit options Ben proposed.
- Accept SCCs with Redwood’s addendum (no separate transfer-impact addendum required).

I’ve attached a short one-page mark (summary) and a tracked-change version. If CareBridge wants a more permissive delegation clause we need exec-level signoff and indemnity carveouts — that will slow review.

Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Susan — bringing this back to you after internal review. Short executive summary you can share at your procurement board:

- Legal: No blocker. Redwood will accept SCCs + our standard transfer addendum for the EU-only pilot. We will not require a separate transfer-impact addendum if CareBridge agrees to the controller obligations in the DPA redline (see DPA_Summary_1page.pdf).
- Delegation: Redwood proposes constrained sub-delegation (30-day notice for new processors; opt-out for critical categories). If CareBridge requires prior written approval for every subprocessor, that needs escalated legal negotiation and potential commercial concessions.
- Commercial: Ben proposes $9,500 one-time setup surcharge, or a 50% offset if CareBridge signs the 12-month committed pilot within 7 business days.

Recommended board motion (drafted for you):
"Approve the pilot subject to Redwood’s standard SCCs + transfer addendum, constrained sub-delegation notice, and the proposed commercial offset of $4,750 upon a 12-month pilot commitment; delegate signoff to the Head of Procurement"

If that motion passes we’ll circulate a DocuSign bundle (OrderForm + DPA tracked) by EOD Wednesday. Let me know if you want the call Monday 12:00 BST — Jordan and Ben will join.

Best,
Laura
